nina (Docs): Short thread: Platform renamed the v2 idempotency header from Idempotency-Key to Request-Id. Need a tiny migration blurb + snippets for docs and SDK examples.

leo (SDK): Can do. I'll keep backwards mapping and emit a deprecation warning in the client.

tay (Platform): Confirming: legacy header accepted for 90 days with a Warning response header, then removed. No immediate rejections.

kim (QA): I'll add two smoke cases: (1) same Request-Id twice -> deduped, (2) Idempotency-Key present -> accepted + Warning header.

leo (SDK): Snippet (JS):
```js
// old
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: 'x', idempotencyKey: id })
// new
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-mini', prompt: 'x', requestId: id })
```

nina (Docs): Add raw HTTP example and a one-line "how to verify" for customers. I'll open the docs PR and tag you.

deploy-bot: Canary updated: v2 will emit Warning header when Idempotency-Key used.

nina (Docs): Action items: leo (SDK PR), kim (smoke tests), tay (confirm rollout window in infra ticket). Target: merge docs + SDK 48h before deprecation email.
